statement: ∀ (C b : ℝ) (F : ℝ → ℝ≥0∞), 0 < b → (∀ h : ℝ, 0 < h → h ≤ 1 → F h ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C*h^b)) → Filter.liminf F (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) ≤ 0
proof:
intro C b F hb hF
have hp := h_T004.2.2.2.positive_limit b hb
have ht : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => C*h^b) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
  simpa using hp.const_mul C
have ht' : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (C*h^b)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds 0) := by
  simpa using ENNReal.tendsto_ofReal ht
have h1 : ∀ᶠ h : ℝ in nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0), h < 1 :=
  Filter.mem_of_superset (Filter.mem_of_superset (Iio_mem_nhds (show (0:ℝ)<1 by norm_num)) (fun _ hh => hh) |> fun hh => nhdsWithin_le_nhds hh) (fun _ hh => hh)
rw [← ht'.liminf_eq]
apply Filter.liminf_le_liminf
· filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin, h1] with h hh hh1
  exact hF h hh hh1.le
· isBoundedDefault
· isBoundedDefault
